checks.note: lockUserAccount's body is findOneByLogin(login).map(u -> u.lock()) guarded only by @PreAuthorize(SecurityConstants.HAS_ADMIN_ROLE) (Javadoc: "Requires ADMIN or LTD_ADMIN role") — no privileged-target or self check exists anywhere in the method, so any login passed in, including a ROLE_ADMIN account or the caller's own, gets locked. Per the finding's caveat this is latent (no production caller shown), and the AuthService lockout consequence is asserted outside this file, but the missing guard itself is confirmed.
